lyrics: Meet me where the shadows lie
Meet me by the broken stile
Keep your voices low and dry
We ain't here to reconcile.
They say we're fools who fear the new
Who fight the march of iron gears
But what's a man supposed to do
When his trade of twenty   years...
...Is murdered by a
water frame?    That starves his kids to fan its
flame? (fan it's flame)    They have no conscience, feel
no shame So we'll answer it with
weight!
This ain't no quarrel   with the King
We've petitioned, bowed, and scraped
But all our pleas don't mean a thing
When our future's being re-shaped
By men in rooms we'll never see
Who count their gold while we count bones
They call it "progress,"   "industry"
We call it theft in   brick and stone.
That murdered our
new water frame? (water frame) That starved our kids
to fan its flame? (fan its flame) They have no conscience,
feel no shame So we'll answer it with
weight!
(weight)
(weight)
(weight)
They call us brutes, they   call us mob
Afraid of what   the future brings
But General Ludd is   on the job
To break the parts, not   just the strings.
So bring the hammer, bring the crow
We'll work by night in the factory's glow
This ain't no riot, this ain't no crime
It's justice served   on the master's
dime.         They murdered us with
that damn frame! (damn frame)    They starved our kids
to fan its flame! (fan its flame) They have no conscience,
feel no shame! So we'll answer it with
weight!
(weight)
(weight)
(weight)
By the hammer's swing...
By the iron's ring...
General Ludd is King!
